items.question: Where has Aerial Powers played in the WNBA?
items.answer: Aerial Powers is a guard who has played for the Dallas Wings (2016 to 2018), Washington Mystics (2018 to 2020), Minnesota Lynx (2021 to 2023), Atlanta Dream (2024), Golden State Valkyries (2025) and Indiana Fever (2025).

items.question: How tall is Aerial Powers?
items.answer: The WNBA lists Aerial Powers at 5 feet 11 inches and 170 pounds.

items.question: What were Aerial Powers' 2025 numbers?
items.answer: In 2025, Aerial Powers played 2 regular season games for the Golden State Valkyries and 8 for the Indiana Fever. She averaged 9.0 points, 4.6 rebounds and 2.4 assists with Indiana. Her WNBA career scoring average is 10.3 points per game.

items.question: Did Aerial Powers play for the Indiana Fever?
items.answer: Yes. The Indiana Fever signed Aerial Powers to a seven-day hardship contract on August 23, 2025, after she had played for the Golden State Valkyries earlier that season. She played 8 regular season games and 8 playoff games for Indiana.

items.question: Did Aerial Powers play at Michigan State?
items.answer: Yes. Aerial Powers played three seasons at Michigan State and was the first three-time All-Big Ten First Team pick in school history.

items.question: Is Aerial Powers a gamer?
items.answer: Yes. Aerial Powers streams video games on Twitch under the name Powerzsurge. Team Liquid signed her as a streamer, brand ambassador and diversity ambassador in January 2021.

items.question: Has Aerial Powers won a WNBA championship?
items.answer: Yes. Aerial Powers won the 2019 WNBA championship with the Washington Mystics, averaging 7.6 points in nine playoff games.
